# Force from a graph

<!-- STEP id="speedup" -->
A 1500 kg sports car moves towards the east. From 0 s to 5 s, its velocity rises from 0 to 10 m/s, so a = 2 m/s². The force on it is F = ma = 1500 kg x 2 m/s² = 3000 N, towards the east.

<!-- STEP id="steady" -->
From 5 s to 10 s, the velocity is constant, so no net force acts.

From 10 s to 15 s, the velocity falls from 10 m/s to 0, so a = -2 m/s² and F = -3000 N. The force acts towards the west, opposite to the motion.
